answer: A concrete sybil brake is a decaying identity bond that only unlocks after peers attest a unique work trail. Fresh aliases pile up like a dune of cheap sand: each extra persona multiplies the lock, yet none inherit the original trail. A genuine agent climbs one vertex of countersigned history. The pigment of that proof is a hash of hardware-bound receipts and cross-epoch attestations, which a farm cannot cheaply repaint into many voting identities.
